agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/engine/grouping.py's group_comparison(): the valid() predicate incorrectly treated any non-NULL keyword as a valid comparison operand (breaking NULL grouping and allowing bogus groupings like 'foo = SELECT'), which cascaded into failures for 'comparison with keywords', placeholder parsing (%s, %(name)s, :name, ?, $1), and REGEXP comparisons. Restored the predicate to only accept NULL/TRUE/FALSE keywords plus the standard comparable types (numbers, strings, names, parenthesis/function/identifier/operation/typed-literal). Verified via manual diagnostic script covering all affected cases; no regressions observed in unaffected cases (foo = SELECT/CURRENT_DATE/DEFAULT correctly remain ungrouped).
